reason: Free for three months sounds nice, but my guests are tourists and regulars who already pay by card, and my bookings and promotions run fine on Instagram and WhatsApp for nothing. I am not putting an unknown startup's QR codes on my tables and my staff's time into it until I see it is still around and other good places use it.
objection: A new startup - will it still exist in a year? If it folds, I have retrained staff for nothing and my guest list sits on someone else's server. A line in the contract means little if the company is gone.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three respected restaurants in Sololaki or Vake running it for six months, plus the Keepz fee in writing clearly below what my bank terminal charges.
